> ICON ILLUSTRATION ASSETS

MATCHING RECORDS: 9

  • OpenMoji:
    100% open-source emoji and vector icon library providing direct downloads of full SVG/PNG sets for local design workflows.
  • Humaaans:
    Free vector illustration construction kit allowing users to mix and match modular human character elements under a CC BY license.
  • ManyPixels Illustration Gallery:
    Royalty-free gallery of customizable SVG and PNG illustrations available for personal and commercial use without login or attribution.
  • Iconoir:
    Massive MIT-licensed open-source vector icon library providing zero-friction SVG downloads and clean development framework integration.
  • SVG Repo:
    Open-access vector directory housing over 500,000 royalty-free SVGs for direct download or raw code copying without account walls.
  • Openclipart:
    Community-driven library of vector graphics published under CC0 Public Domain, completely free for unrestricted personal and commercial use.
  • CSS ICON:
    An ultra-lightweight, CC0-licensed open-source set of pure CSS icons created by Wenting Zhang. Zero external fonts, zero SVG images, and zero JS dependencies—just copy and paste single-div HTML/CSS.
  • pngimg:
    A massive, zero-signup public library of over 100,000 isolated PNG images with transparent backgrounds, freely available under Creative Commons (CC BY-NC 4.0) for non-commercial design and composite workflows.
  • Servier Medical Art (SMART):
    A zero-signup public library of over 3,000 professional medical, biological, and anatomical illustrations released under Creative Commons (CC BY 3.0) for research, publication, and visual design workflows.
